raw_excerpt: MDN: View Transition API. Same-document view transitions supported in Chrome 111+. Cross-document view transitions supported in Chrome 126+. Pattern: document.startViewTransition(() => { DOM mutation }). API captures old and new states as pseudo-elements ::view-transition, ::view-transition-group, ::view-transition-image-pair, ::view-transition-old, ::view-transition-new. view-transition-name is a CSS property that names a snapshot target. Currently cross-document transitions require opt-in via @view-transition rule in both source and destination documents. Limited Firefox support (same-document only as of mid-2024). Defer to v2 — v1 is one long page, not navigation between pages.
